**Target 6 - NewAllStrings wrong package and purpose:**
- Required: `validation.NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator) fyne.StringValidator` in data/validation package (data/validation/all.go)
- This should be a validator combinator that chains multiple StringValidator instances, returning first error
- Actual: Added to data/binding/bindlists.go as a binding helper (wrong package, wrong purpose)

**Target 7 - Missing SetSystemTrayIcon:**
- Required: desktop.App interface needs TWO methods: SetSystemTrayMenu AND SetSystemTrayIcon
- Task says: "SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu)" AND "SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource)"
- Actual: driver/desktop/app.go only has SetSystemTrayMenu, missing SetSystemTrayIcon

From task specification:
"validation.NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator) fyne.StringValidator — Add a validator combinator in the data/validation package (data/validation/all.go). "desktop.App interface — Define a new interface in driver/desktop/app.go with two methods: SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu) — sets the system tray menu; SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource) — sets the system tray icon"
